title: Francis:
title_short: Francis · Eggs Are Expensive Right Now
headline: A 73-year-old neighbor in the car line names what was in her bag, eggs, potatoes, cheese, and why she came back a second time. The joy is the moment she tells her age.
story: Francis is a neighbor, 73, filmed by Kalindi in the passenger seat of her car in the Adopt-A-Block line on 10 Oct. It is her second time. Her sister and her niece told her about it. She loves the stuff that y’all give: plenty of eggs (Eggs are expensive right now), potatoes, cheese, something she can use. When Kalindi asks how long she has lived in Dallas she laughs: Because I’m 73 years old. She turns 74 this month.

Series: Faces of the Dream Center. First name only, verbal consent on camera. Hopeful, never somber: the prices are one line, then the bag, then the laugh, then her hope that the community keeps coming together. Nothing about gas, the economy or the money line. Her Are You Happy block (from 02:04) belongs to the AYH series and is not in this cut.

Loops: L1 “What was in the bag?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:11 (eggs, potatoes, cheese). L2 “Why does she keep coming back?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the BUTTON (“the community will still come together”). Stakes: groceries she could not buy this month.
do: Open on her face in the car, already talking, with the hook text on screen at 0:00.
Keep it her voice. Kalindi’s questions are cut out, except her one line “You look amazing” if the laugh does not play without it.
Name super at 0:11, not before: Francis / Neighbor. First name only.
Cut the bags of food and the milk under the bag lines, then come back to her face.
Stay on her face for the 73 moment. It is the best 8 seconds of the clip.

dont: No logo, no name, no fade at 0:00.
Do NOT use the gas, economy or money lines (01:27 to 02:04). Nothing about prices beyond the one hook line, and never a number or a dollar on screen.
Do NOT use her Are You Happy block (02:04 to 02:49). It belongs to the AYH series, owner Atdhe.
No trash, empty boxes or clutter in any B-roll shot.
Do NOT use the “community together” line as the hook. Robin’s cut (13317239011) and the montage already carry that shape. Here it is the button only.
No last name, no age card, no number on screen. Her age is in her own words only.

decisions.b: The other Dream Center cuts keep the videographer out. Here “You look amazing” is what makes Francis laugh. Ardit tries the laugh without it first; if it does not land, the line stays and Nick decides at V1.

The client rule is that the first cut from a shoot (Kacie’s “500 to 2,500”, due 21 Oct) goes to Kacie for style approval, then the rest are batched. If Kacie’s notes land before you start this one, read them first.

client_note: Dream Center wants joy, dignity and hope with personal and community shots. Francis is the neighbor’s view of the same car line Candice stands in, and her laugh is the most joyful 8 seconds in the day’s interviews.
